DiceClock.Title: Dice Clock
DiceClock.RoomHint: Search a room / Change floor (-1 point)

ResetDialog.Title: Reset the clock
ResetDialog.Content: Reset the clock to its starting state?

Chat.ResetBody: It is {hour}. The dice show their maximum value.
Chat.ChimeBody: The clock strikes. It is now {hour}.

DiceClock.DefaultCriticalMessage: The dice have run out: time is up.

DiceClockDiceCount.Name: Number of dice
DiceClockDiceCount.Hint: Number of dice used by the clock.

DiceClockFaces.Name: Faces per die
DiceClockFaces.Hint: Number of faces on each die (6 for d6).

DiceClockPipMinutes.Name: Minutes per point
DiceClockPipMinutes.Hint: Duration in minutes represented by one point (pip) removed.

DiceClockStartHour.Name: Starting hour
DiceClockStartHour.Hint: Hour shown at the start of the countdown (18 for 18:00).

DiceClockSoundPath.Name: Chime sound
DiceClockSoundPath.Hint: Path to the audio file played on every full hour (e.g. modules/dice-clock/sounds/chime.mp3). Leave empty to disable the sound.

DiceClockCriticalMessage.Name: Final message
DiceClockCriticalMessage.Hint: Message sent to chat when all the clock's points are spent.
